audience: HR staff and managers of German small and medium businesses that track time with clockin

useCases.title: See who is on absence in the coming weeks
useCases.text: Search absences by start date, then open one to see its details. Read the employee record to find out who is away.

useCases.title: Review absence requests waiting for approval
useCases.text: Search absences by approval state to list the requests still pending. Read the employee record for each request.

useCases.title: Add up project hours for a month
useCases.text: Get the work days of employees for a date range. Sum the activities by project id to get the hours for each project, then read the project for its name.

useCases.title: List open projects with their assigned staff
useCases.text: List the projects with their assigned employees and sub-projects. Open one project to read its details.

useCases.title: Book a vacation or workshop absence
useCases.text: Find the employee by last name, then create an absence with a category set up in clockin, such as vacation or workshop. Set the approval to granted, denied or pending.

useCases.title: Record a back-dated start of work
useCases.text: Find the employee by last name, then record a clock event such as a back-dated start of work. The task id sets the event type, for example working time or pause.
